name: live_dialogue_dlc_ulysses
description: Lonesome Road's Ulysses, in his temple. Ulysses says two of his combat lines, as script 0100C796 has him say them: NVDLC04UlyssesREF.Say NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt01, then NVDLC04UlyssesREF.Say NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt01. Each call reaches GameState::coop_talk, and DialogueBridge::forced_frame says the line to everyone through a host session on Ulysses. The host said two lines, and both peers played both. Needs LonesomeRoad.esm.
